en-US.title: Watch Wise: Watch Faces
en-US.shortDescription: Bold watch faces for Wear OS. Pick on your phone, set on your watch in one tap.
en-US.fullDescription:
Watch Wise is a collection of bold, clean watch faces for your Wear OS watch, with a phone companion that makes choosing one easy.

7 DESIGNS, 28 LOOKS
• Mono Stack, Dot Matrix, Ember Forest, Shell Window, Shell Full, Stack and Terminal
• Big stacked digits, retro dot-matrix, terminal-style status and more
Every design comes in four accent colours.

USEFUL AT A GLANCE
• Time and date, battery, steps, heart rate and weather, depending on the design
• Battery-friendly always-on (ambient) mode
• Built with Google's Watch Face Format

PICK ON YOUR PHONE
• Browse every face in large previews on your phone
• Choose an accent colour
• Tap "Set on watch" and it becomes your watch face

OR RIGHT ON YOUR WATCH
• The watch app works on its own, no phone needed
• Scroll the list, preview, pick an accent and set it

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Your watch shows health and battery data directly from the system; the app never collects it

Requirements: setting a face from the app needs Wear OS 6 or newer. Install Watch Wise on your watch from the Play Store on your watch or from the phone app listing.

releaseNotes.en-US: First release of Watch Wise: 7 watch face designs in 4 accent colours, with a phone companion to set them in one tap.
